title: AURORA agent frontmatter
description: Shape of the YAML frontmatter at the top of every agents/<name>.md file. Validates structure only; the prompt body is checked by tests/agents/test_prompt_invariants.py (T-G2).

name.description: Snake/kebab-case agent identifier; must match the filename without .md.

description.description: Plain-English summary used by the Claude Code agent picker.

tools.description: Either a comma-separated string or an array of Claude Code tool names. Must be non-empty.

fleet.description: Which AURORA fleet the agent belongs to.

aliases.description: Optional alternate names the agent answers to.

model.description: Optional explicit Claude model name (e.g. opus, sonnet, haiku); informational only — routing is governed by model_tier.
